components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR and is used to compose the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied.
            On read it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; a non-blank value
            supplies the owner's address. Normalized on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '[\s\S]*\S[\s\S]*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already belongs to the same household (the same lastName and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Otherwise such a request
            is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and lastName separated by a
                single space when a title is present, or just the lastName when
                no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region derived from the owner's postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when the postcode maps to no known region) and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3C1A9F2B'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3C1A9F2B-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is labelled by the two-digit calendar year in which it
                ends, so a registrationDate of 2026-09-04 falls in fiscal year
                'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                the normalized lastName and postcode. Every owner sharing the same
                lastName and postcode is assigned the same householdId
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3C1A9F2B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is
                present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3
                or more, and add 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the '<REGION>' component of the
                customerCode (its prefix up to the first '-'), i.e. the region
                derived from the owner's postcode at creation, or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, the IANA name derived from the locality via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day. True once the daily
                total exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the owner capacity limit of 50: true when the city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise false. The hard
                rejection at 50 is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+', the
                country calling code, a space, and the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces. The raw telephone stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone, the
                email (lower-cased, or empty when absent) and the Soundex of the
                lastName, joined with '|' before hashing. Two owners are
                duplicates, and the second is rejected with 409, only when their
                whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3c1a9f2b7d4e5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0011223344556677889900aabbccddee'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (a single digit 0-9) computed over the
                decimal digits contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was a soft match
                for an existing owner: not a hard duplicate, but sharing that
                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. The
                owner is still created; true flags the soft match, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean

            possibleDuplicateOf:

              type: integer

                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:

              description: >-

              example: '/api/owners/1'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR and is used to compose the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied.
            On read it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; a non-blank value
            supplies the owner's address. Normalized on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '[\s\S]*\S[\s\S]*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already belongs to the same household (the same lastName and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Otherwise such a request
            is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and lastName separated by a
                single space when a title is present, or just the lastName when
                no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member ID, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode maps to no known
                region), the 2-digit fiscal-year code FY of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends),
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters HASH8 of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName, and
                a single Luhn check digit CHK computed over the decimal digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On the rare collision with an existing
                owner's memberId a '-<n>' suffix is appended to make it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273C1A9F2B4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is labelled by the two-digit calendar year in which it
                ends, so a registrationDate of 2026-09-04 falls in fiscal year
                'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                the normalized lastName and postcode. Every owner sharing the same
                lastName and postcode is assigned the same householdId
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3C1A9F2B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is
                present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3
                or more, and add 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the '<REGION>' component of the
                customerCode (its prefix up to the first '-'), i.e. the region
                derived from the owner's postcode at creation, or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, the IANA name derived from the locality via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day. True once the daily
                total exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the owner capacity limit of 50: true when the city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise false. The hard
                rejection at 50 is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+', the
                country calling code, a space, and the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces. The raw telephone stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone, the
                email (lower-cased, or empty when absent) and the Soundex of the
                lastName, joined with '|' before hashing. Two owners are
                duplicates, and the second is rejected with 409, only when their
                whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3c1a9f2b7d4e5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0011223344556677889900aabbccddee'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (a single digit 0-9) computed over the
                decimal digits contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was a soft match
                for an existing owner: not a hard duplicate, but sharing that
                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. The
                owner is still created; true flags the soft match, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (same lastName and postcode, different telephone), or absent
                when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted while
                retaining the record, after which it is still returned by GET
                /api/owners/{id} with this flag true and is ignored by the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

              title: Salutation
              description: >-

                single space when a title is present, or just the lastName when
                no title was given.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

              title: Initials

                postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode maps to no known
                region), the 2-digit fiscal-year code FY of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends),
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters HASH8 of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName, and
                a single Luhn check digit CHK computed over the decimal digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On the rare collision with an existing
                owner's memberId a '-<n>' suffix is appended to make it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273C1A9F2B4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:

                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is labelled by the two-digit calendar year in which it
                ends, so a registrationDate of 2026-09-04 falls in fiscal year
                'FY27'.

              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                the normalized lastName and postcode. Every owner sharing the same
                lastName and postcode is assigned the same householdId
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3C1A9F2B7D4E'
              readOnly: true

                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-

                present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3
                or more, and add 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4

              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

              title: Timezone

                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
